tasks.name: Choosing a model for each phase of a plan
tasks.text: The user picks, per feature, which configured profile each phase runs on, before or while the feature is being worked.
tasks.note: B5 (retrieval sub-session) cannot be wired against real retrieval code because that feature does not exist yet in the codebase (confirmed absent; tracked only in docs/features/retrieval-subsession.md). Proven instead by the structural guarantee that phase-choices only ever resolves the step actually named, so a step retrieval would resolve on (not itself a `PhaseStepName`) is never reached by a choice made for the calling phase. B3/E1's session-level wiring lives in chat-view-provider.ts, which (like extension.ts) is this codebase's untested composition root by established convention (no chat-view-provider.test.ts exists); its behaviour is proven at the pure-function level it is built from (`shouldApplyPhaseChoice`, `resolvePhase`, and the pre-existing, already-tested `SessionManager.setProfile`/`continuationOf` for B4), plus the fact each implement task's run is created fresh (pre-existing one-run-per-task convention), not by a test of chat-view-provider.ts itself. Storage mechanism for B7 (per feature and per user) was left open by the spec; chose `context.workspaceState` under key `modelChoices`, mirroring the existing `SessionStore` pattern (`context.workspaceState['sessions']`) already used for per-window session state. The `set_phase_profile` webview message takes no `feature`; like `approve_spec`/`check_spec`/etc. it derives the feature from the active plan session server-side (`planRecordOf(shown)`), matching the codebase's existing convention rather than trusting the client to name it.
tasks.built: Pure, tested logic: `resolvePhase(step, chosen, profiles, providers, settingsDefault): PhaseProfile` and `phaseRefusalMessage(step, resolution)` and `sameModelProfile(a,b)` in src/agent/session/model-profile.ts. `isPhaseStep(step)`, `PHASE_STEPS: readonly PhaseStepName[]`, `PhaseStepName`, `PhaseChoices`/`FeaturePhaseChoices`, `PhaseChoiceStore {read,save}`, `choiceFor(choices,feature,step)`, `chooseProfile(store,feature,step,name)` and `shouldApplyPhaseChoice(status,current,resolution)` in src/agent/session/phase-choices.ts (new file). Wiring in src/extension.ts: `phaseChoiceStore: PhaseChoiceStore` backed by `context.workspaceState['modelChoices']` (B7), and `phaseProfileFor(store, mode, feature): PhaseProfile`, passed into ChatViewProvider as `profileFor: (mode, feature?) => PhaseProfile`. src/chat/chat-view-provider.ts: constructor takes `profileFor` and `phaseChoices: PhaseChoiceStore`; `resolvedProfile(mode, feature)` resolves and, on B6 refusal, prompts to run on the settings default; `applyPhaseChoice(run)` re-resolves and swaps a live session's profile via `sessions.setProfile` before its next `send`, gated by `shouldApplyPhaseChoice`; all 6 session-creation call sites (`newSession`, `startCheck`, `startImplementing`, `handToImplementer`, `runCleanup`, `describeDocs`) now resolve through `resolvedProfile`; `planState()` adds `phaseProfiles: PhaseProfileState[]` (one row per phase, B8) via `phaseProfileState(step, feature)`; `case 'set_phase_profile'` calls `chooseProfile` and re-sends state. src/chat/protocol.ts adds `PlanState.phaseProfiles`, `PhaseProfileState` (`{step,name,isDefault}` or `{step,missing}`), and `FromWebview`'s `set_phase_profile {step, name?}`. Webview: `PhaseProfileChangedEvent(step, name)` in events.ts; `PlanBar.update(plan, profileNames)` renders one labelled `<select class="phase-profile">` per phase (B8), dispatching the event on change; `ChatApp` tracks `profileNames` from `state.profiles.names` and forwards the event as `set_phase_profile`. Test fixture `test/plan-state-fixture.ts`'s `planState()` now includes a default `phaseProfiles` array other tests build on.

tasks.name: Switching model in a chat session
tasks.text: A chat session runs on one profile at a time and the user can change it mid-conversation.

proves.item: B9: a chat session's model is its own, switchable at any point, independent of any feature's phase choices
E2: a plan session names its current phase's profile in the composer, with no switch offered there
B10: a switch applies at once when the session is idle or stopped on the user, but waits out a turn in flight
B11: a switch within the same engine keeps the conversation; a switch across engines drops the engine session id
B12: switching one chat session's profile leaves another live chat session running on what it had
B13: the transcript records each switch where it happened, in the scrolling transcript, not only the status line

tasks.note: Fixed the flagged B13 finding: session_started now marks a real model change in the scrolling transcript (switchMarker), not just the status line, and a same-model restart leaves no mark. Found and fixed two further gaps while reading closely: (1) E2 - the composer previously showed nothing at all for a plan/phase tab; extended ModelSwitch to an options-less read-only mode, wired via message.plan's presence as the plan-session signal. (2) B10 - set_session_model went straight to SessionManager.setProfile, which disposes the engine and aborts an in-flight turn; added appliesModelSwitchNow + a pendingModelSwitch map (mirroring the existing applyPhaseChoice/shouldApplyPhaseChoice precedent) so a switch mid-turn is held and applied right before the next send. ChatViewProvider's switchModel/applyPendingModelSwitch wiring has no dedicated test, following existing repo precedent (no test harness anywhere instantiates ChatViewProvider, which depends on vscode); only the extracted pure appliesModelSwitchNow is unit-tested. B12's "a chat session starts on the active-profile setting" half is structurally guaranteed by pre-existing profileFor/phaseProfileFor in extension.ts (no feature ⇒ always profileFor(mode) from kiwiAgent.activeProfile); not directly tested since extension.ts has no test harness in this repo.
tasks.built: appliesModelSwitchNow(status) in src/agent/session/session-status.ts (pure: gates B10's immediate-vs-deferred switch). switchModel/applyPendingModelSwitch/pendingModelSwitch in ChatViewProvider (src/chat/chat-view-provider.ts): the gated entry point for 'set_session_model', applied on the run's next send. ModelSwitch type extended to {current, options?} in chat-composer.ts, with a read-only .model-current display when options is omitted (plan sessions) vs a <select> when present (chat sessions). switchMarker(event) in chat-transcript.ts inserts a scrolling-transcript marker on an actual model change.
